name: @genoffice/ai-provider
description: Redrob AI layer. Keeps the @genoffice/ai-provider TypeScript surface the ported editor apps import, and runs every chat/stream turn on the bundled Redrob engine (redrob-code), which holds every provider credential and makes the call. Office names a provider/model (default redrob/auto), hosts its own tools for the engine over loopback MCP, holds no key and honours no configured inference URL. A failure is a visible failure, never a silent swap.
